name: project-template
description: Portable project template - provider-neutral and platform-agnostic. No secrets or protected runtime values are embedded.

wordpress.notes: Example WordPress profile. Requires External Secret configuration for database and provider runtime.

lovable.notes: Lovable site profile. Runtime/provider credentials are supplied externally.

react.notes: React SPA profile with static export. No secrets in template.

nextjs.notes: Next.js (nextjs) profile. Server/runtime settings provided externally.

static.notes: Static site profile for plain HTML/CSS/JS.

php.notes: Generic PHP profile without CMS assumptions.

generic_git.notes: Generic Git profile for arbitrary projects not tied to a specific framework.

custom.notes: Custom adapter profile stub. Implement adapter-specific behavior outside this template.
